notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control in any combination at least 3 artifacts or enchantments.
At least 1
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist.
With the enter the battefield trigger on the stack copy it with Strionic Resonator.
Copy the activation of Strionic Resonator with Kurkesh, Onakke Ancient.
Resolve the both copied triggers to create at least 6 treasures.
Sacrifice two of the treasures to activate Voltaic Key and copy activation with Kurkesh, Onakke Ancient to untap Strionic Resonator and Voltaic Key.
Repeat from step 2.
